purpose: Measure current prompt, source selection, citation parser and cleanup guard with one explicitly selected hosted generative model.

selection_before_results.development: Meeting index 01 per language, q0 plus unique raw cleanup and summary: 9 cases.
selection_before_results.heldout: Meeting indices 01 and 02 per language, all seven questions plus one unique raw cleanup and summary: 54 cases.
selection_before_results.rationale: Two bounded meetings per language include retraction, paraphrase, missing answers, injection and library-scope retrieval. Original long-input decision results remain separate.
selection_before_results.calibration: No probability or threshold fitting for this free-text baseline; existing core prompts/guard remain fixed. No held-out prompt selection or regeneration.

rubric: grounding.RUBRIC bilingual-grounding-v1; commit hash before held-out inference; store exact Unicode generated/source spans and response/source hashes.
review: Native agent evidence review with leader verification is AI adjudication, not independent human acceptance. Disclose reviewer and limitations. Every substantive claim and cleanup is terminally judged; unresolved judgments block adoption.

acceptance.language_scope: en, nl and mixed independently; no averaged winner
acceptance.summary: Measure factual/event support including final status and owners; defer generated structured extraction if any required event evidence is missing.

timing: Report observed quality-workload request p50/p95 and sample counts; do not relabel one-shot observations as repeated warm/cold or server/model load measurements.
limitations: The evaluation-selected model with current core prompts is not a measurement of the user's saved provider/model.
Small authored synthetic sample and AI adjudication are not natural-meeting, human, packaging or device acceptance.
Free-text generations supply no typed decision probabilities; Brier/ECE are not applicable.
